vo: Four AI names showed up on three screens at once this week. The halal screen. The value screen. And congress's own trading disclosures.
Nvidia. Synopsys. Microsoft. Meta. Every one passes all five compliance standards, and every one trades below its modeled fundamental value. Nvidia sits forty one percent below.
Congress members disclosed over three hundred trades across these four names. Public record, filed under the STOCK Act. Disclosures, not endorsements.
The math is on the screen. Check it yourself before trusting anyone's opinion, including this one. Educational, not financial or religious advice.
